description:
Takes the signal bundle a caller actually has — name, email, phone, dob, address, external_id — and answers which person it is about. Tenant comes from the credential; there is no parameter with which to match inside somebody else's data.

THREE ANSWERS, AND ONLY ONE OF THEM LINKS. 'exact_crosswalk' means a recorded identifier (an app_identity for this app, or an alias hash) already names this person WITHIN this tenant, so linking is a fact rather than a judgement; person_id is returned. 'possibly_same' means the bundle scored at/above EMPI_CANDIDATE_MIN against one of the tenant's own linked records: a POSSIBLY_SAME candidate link is raised for steward review and returned as case_id with its confidence, and nothing is merged. 'no_match' means nothing scored high enough to be worth a steward's time.

WHY IT EXISTS. The capability manifest advertised this operation at /api/resolver/resolve, which has never done it — that route reads an identity context for a person_id you already have — so every consumer that sent traits got 400. Worse, matchAndLink had no caller anywhere in the platform, so empi.candidate_link could only be populated by hand and the steward review queue was structurally empty.

WRITES ARE DELIBERATELY NARROW. A crosswalk hit writes nothing. A no_match writes nothing — promotion is a governed act with its own endpoint, and registering a person for every inbound trait bundle would populate the identity graph from unreviewed input. Only 'possibly_same' registers a coexistence person for the incoming record, because a candidate link needs two person ids by construction, plus alias rows for the identifiers supplied so the NEXT capture is a crosswalk hit rather than a second case.

Candidate traits are read from the tenant's own normalised source records rather than from identity.alias, which stores a hash and an encrypted envelope — checkable, deliberately not readable, and therefore useless for 'is this name a bit like that name'.

errorCases.message: traits must carry at least one of name, email, phone, dob, address, external_id
errorCases.when: the bundle is empty or every trait is blank. Answering no_match instead would report an absence nobody looked for.
